aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: At 53, Chinese immigrant Feng Xia secretly pursues her long-repressed attraction to women through an affair with a younger Québécoise in Montreal.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After decades of suppressing her true identity, 53-year-old Chinese immigrant Feng Xia finds herself at a transformative turning point while living in Montreal. She chooses to confront her repressed romantic and sexual feelings for women, stepping outside the bounds of her familiar life. Embarking on a passionate, secret love affair with a young Québécoise woman, Feng Xia begins to reexamine her sense of self, culture, and desire. As her hidden relationship deepens, she must navigate the complex realities of living between two worlds.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Settled into middle age in Canada, 53-year-old Chinese immigrant Feng Xia has spent most of her life fulfilling cultural expectations and burying her personal desires. However, living in the vibrant, culturally diverse backdrop of Montreal gradually exposes the emotional void she has long ignored. Unwilling to live the remainder of her life in quiet resignation, Feng Xia makes the bold decision to confront her deeply repressed attraction to women. This breakthrough leads her to cross paths with a young Québécoise woman, sparking an immediate and intense connection. The two soon enter into a secret love affair, offering Feng Xia an intoxicating taste of liberation, intimacy, and romance she had never previously experienced. Yet, managing this dual life brings emotional friction, forcing her to carefully conceal her relationship from her traditional social and family networks. The dynamic between the women highlights fascinating contrasts in age, background, and cultural perspectives, shaping Feng Xia's evolving understanding of freedom and identity. As the affair unfolds, she is forced to examine what true authenticity costs and whether she can permanently embrace her actual self. Ultimately, the story charts a poignant, deeply internal journey of late-blooming self-discovery and love.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the culturally rich landscape of Montreal, this tender and emotional drama follows 53-year-old Feng Xia, a Chinese immigrant who decides to embrace her long-repressed desires for women. Entering into a secretive affair with a younger Québécoise woman, Feng Xia embarks on a powerful journey of late-blooming self-acceptance, navigating the intersection of immigrant identity, middle-age transformation, and unexpected love.

story_structure.climax: The secret affair and the weight of her dual existence reach a breaking point, forcing Feng Xia to face a critical confrontation with her hidden truth and the life she built.
story_structure.conflict: Feng Xia confronts her long-buried romantic and sexual desire for women as she enters into a secret affair with a young Québécoise woman.
story_structure.resolution: Feng Xia comes to terms with the choices before her, establishing a path toward authentic self-acceptance and redefining her place within her heritage and her home in Montreal.
story_structure.introduction: Feng Xia, a 53-year-old Chinese immigrant living in Montreal, leads a quiet life shaped by cultural expectations and repressed personal identity.
story_structure.risingAction: As the hidden relationship deepens, Feng Xia navigates the tensions of leading a double life, balancing her cultural roots, family dynamics, and emerging self-discovery against the threat of exposure.

characters.name: Feng Xia (played by Joan Chen)
characters.description: A 53-year-old Chinese immigrant wife and mother in Montreal who embarks on a journey of self-discovery, confronting her long-repressed sexuality and pursuing a secret romantic affair.

characters.name: Camille (played by Charlotte Aubin)
characters.description: A free-spirited younger Québécoise woman who becomes Feng Xia's love interest and helps awaken her long-buried desires.

characters.name: Wang Jun (played by John Xu)
characters.description: Feng Xia's controlling and abusive husband who opposes her independence and tries to force the family back to China after discovering her affair.

characters.name: Joseph (played by Zion-Luna Valdes)
characters.description: A young queer Cuban immigrant in Feng Xia's French class who openly discusses his identity and introduces her to online dating apps.

characters.name: Joy (played by Pei Yao Xu)
characters.description: Feng Xia's 18-year-old French-speaking daughter who represents a younger generation living with the freedom and ease her mother never had.

characters.name: Dong Dong (played by Anzhe Angelo Zhang)
characters.description: Feng Xia's young son, living as part of the family dynamic amidst the growing tension between his parents.
